central_idea_and_construction: A small serene symbol of one softly cupped vessel enclosing a low, smooth pool-shaped opening, seen as a broad organic bowl silhouette rather than a literal outlined teacup. No handle, steam or scene. Center this symbol above the exact Korean word 고요. Custom Korean lettering is gently brush-influenced with moderate stroke weight, rounded meeting points and open spacing, no handwritten ambiguity. Preserve the complete 고 and 요 syllable blocks. Symbol about 28% canvas width, word about 45%, ample white interval between. One cohesive warm brown ink. Gentle, intimate tea-room identity; no architectural bars or Zen landscape clichés.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Cupped silhouette and the unambiguous 고요 syllables.
specific_risk: Vessel can become generic; overly loose brush curves could damage Hangul.
